reproduction.measure.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,shutil,json
p=Path('/tmp/gma-m4-bottosson');repo=Path('/home/lloydk/work/gma-benchmark');baseline=Path('/tmp/gma-m4-bottosson-baseline')
rows=[]
for i,version in enumerate(['before','after','after','before']):
 source=baseline if version=='before' else repo
 dest=p/'timed'
 if dest.exists():shutil.rmtree(dest)
 (dest/'scripts').mkdir(parents=True)
 shutil.copytree(source/'src',dest/'src')
 for name in ['package.json','bench.js','benchmark-workloads.js']:shutil.copy2(source/name,dest/name)
 shutil.copy2(repo/'scripts/bench-rgb-kernels.mjs',dest/'scripts/bench-rgb-kernels.mjs')
 (dest/'node_modules').symlink_to(repo/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
 for runtime in ['node','bun']:
  for gamut in (['display-p3'] if version=='before' else ['display-p3','srgb','rec2020']):
   for method in ['bottosson-lightness','bottosson-lightness-cached']:
    result=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','2',runtime,'scripts/bench-rgb-kernels.mjs','--gamut',gamut,'--method',method],cwd=dest,text=True))
    result.update(runtimeName=runtime,version=version,run=i);rows.append(result)
  flags=['--expose-gc'] if runtime=='node' else []
  with (p/f'full-{version}-{runtime}-{i}.log').open('w') as log:
   subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','2',runtime,*flags,'bench.js','--timing-only'],cwd=dest,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  print(version,i,runtime,flush=True)
 (p/'timings.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

notes: Parity is measured against Rust f64; JS does not implement the Rust f32 compensation path.
Approximation quality and policy arithmetic are independently measured; Bottosson is not a first-exit solver.
Canonical checks preserve signed negative chroma too when the original input converts in gamut, matching Rust.
sRGB/Rec.2020 have no incumbent JS Bottosson baseline; their numbers are final throughput only.
Rust runtime code and generated fit files are unchanged; Rust timings were not repeated.
